Back to app: Inkplainer takes your images and text and turns them into videos that look like someone is drawing them by hand in real time — the kind of effect you see in explainer videos, educational content, and social media animations. You upload your content, choose how it should be drawn, hit Generate, and the app animates it frame by frame on a canvas. When you're happy with the result, you export it as a video file.

Sube tu contenido, elige cómo dibujarlo y pulsa Generar. La aplicación lo anima fotograma a fotograma en el lienzo. Cuando te guste el resultado, expórtalo como video.
